Easy is the wrong word for success. Kevin has a better one.

Kevin Trudeau says he never calls anything easy. Instead he says he will put in massive effort, because he loves the process.

His example is fishing: waking at four in the morning and carrying boats out. Nobody would call it easy, yet he loves every minute.

That is the difference he points to. Enjoy the journey, because the journey is the reward.

What effort do you love enough to never call it hard?

#ad #success #habits #mindset

You did not want the car crash. So how did you create it?

Kevin Trudeau says we create everything in our lives. He knows many people will push back on that.

His answer is to ask how the event made you feel. If the answer is helpless, ask whether you have felt helpless in the last six months.

He says whatever you broadcast, the universe sends back as events that match it.

Do you agree, or is that too far?

Kevin's free training, Your Wish Is Your Command, is in my highlights.

#ad #mindset #fear #success

Bless the teacher who yelled at you. That is the hard part.

Kevin Trudeau recalls the bedtime prayers he said as a child. One blessed everyone, even a teacher he was upset with because she had yelled at him that day.

He says that sent love and good wishes to everyone, enemies included. His reason: whatever you give out will come back. For Kevin, that is the law of attraction.

Who would be hardest for you to wish well?

#ad #love #relationships #happiness
